info.title: 0xArchive API
info.description: REST API for current and historical market data from Hyperliquid and Lighter. Hyperliquid coverage includes core perpetuals, Spot, HIP-3 builder perpetuals, and HIP-4 outcome markets. Coverage and access requirements vary by route. See https://docs.0xarchive.io/ for authentication, limits, and examples.

get.description:
Get historical order book snapshots within a time range with configurable resolution. Checkpoint history starts January 29, 2026; 30s/10s/1s start January 30, 2026. Use 'granularity' parameter to control data resolution.

**Tick-Level Data:**
When `granularity=tick`, the response format changes. Instead of returning snapshots in the `data` array, it returns:
- `checkpoint`: Full orderbook state at the start of the time range
- `deltas`: Array of incremental changes to apply to the checkpoint

This is the most efficient format for reconstructing high-frequency orderbook states. Use the SDK's `OrderBookReconstructor` class for client-side reconstruction.

parameters.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., ETH, BTC)

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start timestamp in Unix milliseconds. Defaults to 24h ago.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End timestamp in Unix milliseconds. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for pagination

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results (default: 100, max: 1000)

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Requested price levels per side. The Lighter native L2 route includes all served levels.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Data resolution: checkpoint (1min, default), 30s, 10s, 1s, tick. Checkpoint history starts January 29, 2026; 30s/10s/1s start January 30, 2026. Billed per row returned (about 1 credit per 1,000 rows, minimum 1 credit per request). Higher resolutions return more rows. **Note:** When granularity=tick, the response format changes to return `checkpoint` and `deltas` instead of a `data` array.

post.description:
x402-protected endpoint for purchasing 30-day Build or Pro access with USDC on Base. Unknown wallets receive an account and API key only after successful payment settlement. Existing disabled wallets are rejected before facilitator verification or settlement.

**Flow:**
1. POST with `{ "tier": "build" }` (no payment header) → Server returns 402 with payment details (amount, pay_to address, network)
2. Sign an EIP-712 `TransferWithAuthorization` (EIP-3009) on USDC Base for the specified amount
3. Build x402 v2 payment payload, base64-encode it, and retry with `payment-signature` header
4. Server verifies and settles payment via the facilitator → grants access → returns API key

SpotTwapRecord.description: Hyperliquid Spot TWAP record. Fields may expand as TWAP coverage fills in for a pair.

L2OrderBookDiff.description: Full-depth L2 aggregate diff event derived from L4 deltas

block_number.description: Hyperliquid block number for the diff event

side.description: Book side: B for bid, A for ask

price.description: Price level changed by this diff

allOf.description: 0xArchive full-depth aggregated L2 order book snapshot derived from L4 data

LiquidationLevelsData.description: Projected forced-liquidation levels computed from clearinghouse positions and margin state (positions plus maintenance-margin tiers), aggregated into price buckets around the snapshot mark price. mid_price.description: Mark price at the snapshot, center of the requested range.

snapshot_ts.description: UTC snapshot time the levels reflect. Treat snapshots older than 2 hours as stale.

block_number.description: Hyperliquid block height the snapshot reflects.

total_long.description: Total long notional at risk across the whole book, not only the returned window.

total_short.description: Total short notional at risk across the whole book.

source.description: Snapshot storage form used to answer the request. raw means query-time bins over stored fine-grained levels; histogram means proportional re-binning of a retained base histogram.

ApiResponseLiquidationLevels.description: API response containing projected forced-liquidation levels for one snapshot.

reference_source.description: Price source used for the bounds.

ApiResponseHip3OracleExternalPrice.description: API response containing HIP-3 oracle external price data.

ApiResponseHip3OracleDiscoveryBounds.description: API response containing HIP-3 oracle discovery bounds.

description.description: Pipe-delimited question metadata (class, underlying, expiry, price thresholds, period).

named_outcome_ids.description: Outcome IDs of the named choices grouped under this question.

settled_named_outcomes.description: Subset of `named_outcome_ids` that have already settled.

first_seen_at.description: When this question was first observed by 0xArchive (UTC).

last_updated_at.description: When this question row was last updated (UTC).

ClassifiedWallet.description: Wallet plus its precomputed behavior metrics.

message.description: SIWE message returned by `/v1/auth/web3/challenge` and signed by the wallet.

email.description: Account email associated with the wallet user.

message.description: Legacy SIWE message field. The retired route does not verify or process it.

signature.description: Legacy personal_sign signature field. The retired route does not verify or process it.

short_notional.description: USD notional of short positions projected to liquidate in this bucket.

short_count.description: Number of short positions in this bucket.

TriggerLevel.description: Aggregated currently open trigger orders at one rounded price bucket.

ask_count.description: Number of ask-side trigger orders in the bucket.

as_of.description: UTC RFC3339 server time the pending-trigger state was read. The map is current-state; use this to detect staleness.

total_bid_size.description: Total pending bid size across the returned window.

total_ask_size.description: Total pending ask size across the returned window.

ApiResponseTriggerLevels.description: API response containing the pending trigger-order map.

TriggerLevelsHistoryItem.description: One historical trigger-levels snapshot (15-minute cadence). levels is omitted when summary=true.

ApiResponseTriggerLevelsHistory.description: Paginated historical trigger-levels snapshots, ascending by snapshot_ts. When a page is full, meta.next_cursor carries the cursor for the next page.

LighterTrade.description: Lighter trade (fill) record. Canonical rows (`source: "bucket"`) come from the daily Lighter Foundation reconcile and carry full enrichment. The `/recent` endpoint serves preliminary real-time rows (`source: "ws"`) without fee/tx_hash/order_id/realized_pnl and the other bucket-only enrichment fields until the daily reconcile finalizes them.

coin.description: Trading pair symbol (deprecated, use symbol instead)

side.description: Trade side of the account this row belongs to: 'B' (buy) or 'A' (sell/ask)

tx_hash.description: Lighter settlement transaction hash (fixed-width hex). Canonical rows only.

trade_id.description: Unique Lighter trade ID. Each trade produces two rows (one per counterparty) sharing this ID.

order_id.description: Order ID of this account's order. Canonical rows only.

crossed.description: True if this account was the taker (crossed the spread), false if maker

fee.description: This account's fee for the fill. Canonical rows only.

account_index.description: Lighter numeric account index this row belongs to (serialized as a string)

source.description: Row provenance: 'bucket' = canonical (finalized by the daily Lighter Foundation reconcile), 'ws' = preliminary real-time capture

position_size_before.description: This account's signed position size before the fill (long positive, short negative)

position_size_after.description: Signed position size after the fill (derived: position_size_before plus/minus size by side)

entry_quote_before.description: This account's position entry quote value before the fill

initial_margin_fraction_before.description: This account's initial margin fraction before the fill

allocated_margin_before.description: Isolated-margin allocation before the fill (0 for cross)

allocated_margin_after.description: Isolated-margin allocation after the fill (0 for cross)

position_sign_changed.description: True if the fill flipped this account's position between long and short

trade_type.description: Upstream trade type. Canonical rows only.

is_maker.description: True if this account was the maker. Canonical rows only.

counterparty_address.description: Counterparty's Lighter account index (serialized as a string). Canonical rows only.

client_id.description: Client-assigned order ID. Canonical rows only.

realized_pnl.description: Matching-engine realized PnL for this fill. Canonical rows only.

integrator_fee.description: Integrator fee charged on the fill. Canonical rows only.

fee_account_id.description: Account credited with the fee. Canonical rows only.

l2_block_height.description: Lighter L2 block height containing the trade. Canonical rows only.

transaction_time_us.description: Intra-block transaction time in microseconds. Canonical rows only.

usdc_amount.description: Notional value of the fill in USDC. Canonical rows only.

ApiResponseLighterTradeArray.description: API response containing an array of Lighter trades. History responses serve canonical rows only and clamp `end` to `finalized_through`; `/recent` responses serve preliminary rows and report `preliminary_row_count`.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Use this value as the `cursor` parameter to fetch the next page. History endpoint only.

finalized_through.description: Timestamp through which canonical (bucket-reconciled) data is available.

requested_end.description: The `end` the caller requested, echoed when it was clamped. History endpoint only.

clamped_to.description: Effective end after clamping to `finalized_through`. History endpoint only.

preliminary_row_count.description: Number of preliminary (`source: "ws"`) rows in this response. `/recent` endpoint only.

LighterLiquidation.description: Native Lighter liquidation event. Margin and fee integer fields are raw upstream units.

timestamp.description: Liquidation timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds

trade_id.description: Unique Lighter trade ID of the liquidation fill

usd_amount.description: Notional value of the liquidation in USD

ask_account.description: Lighter account index on the ask side (serialized as a string)

bid_account.description: Lighter account index on the bid side (serialized as a string)

ask_order_id.description: Order ID on the ask side

bid_order_id.description: Order ID on the bid side

is_maker_ask.description: True if the maker was on the ask side

taker_position_size_before.description: Taker's signed position size before the fill (long positive, short negative)

maker_position_size_before.description: Maker's signed position size before the fill

taker_entry_quote_before.description: Taker's position entry quote value before the fill

maker_entry_quote_before.description: Maker's position entry quote value before the fill

taker_initial_margin_fraction_before.description: Taker's initial margin fraction before the fill (raw upstream units)

maker_initial_margin_fraction_before.description: Maker's initial margin fraction before the fill (raw upstream units)

taker_allocated_margin_usdc_before.description: Taker's isolated-margin USDC allocation before the fill (raw upstream units)

taker_allocated_margin_usdc_after.description: Taker's isolated-margin USDC allocation after the fill (raw upstream units)

maker_allocated_margin_usdc_before.description: Maker's isolated-margin USDC allocation before the fill (raw upstream units)

maker_allocated_margin_usdc_after.description: Maker's isolated-margin USDC allocation after the fill (raw upstream units)

taker_position_sign_changed.description: True if the fill flipped the taker's position between long and short

maker_position_sign_changed.description: True if the fill flipped the maker's position between long and short

block_height.description: Lighter L2 block height containing the liquidation

raw_json.description: Raw upstream payload as received from Lighter.
